title.accountFree: No account needed. Just press Enter and play.
title.menuHint: Up/Down to choose, Enter to select
title.parody: An original satirical parody. Not affiliated with any game publisher.

instructions.heading: How to Play
instructions.goal: Climb the girders and reach Motzfeldt at the top. Dodge the barrels!
instructions.left: Left Arrow or A: move left
instructions.right: Right Arrow or D: move right
instructions.up: Up Arrow or W: climb up a ladder (hold it mid-jump to grab one)
instructions.down: Down Arrow or S: climb down a ladder
instructions.resume: P or Escape: resume while paused
instructions.ladderNote: You cannot jump from one floor to the next. Use the ladders.
instructions.close: Press Escape or Enter to close

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.local: The game runs entirely in your browser.
privacy.noAccounts: There are no accounts and no persistent profiles.
privacy.noAnalytics: There are no third-party analytics, and analytics transmission is disabled for this launch.
privacy.noStorage: Your score is kept in memory only and is gone when you close the page.
privacy.close: Press Escape or Enter to close

pause.heading: Paused
pause.hint: Up/Down to choose, Enter to select, Escape or P to resume

gameOver.heading: GAME OVER
gameOver.title: Press Escape for the title screen

levelComplete.heading: Motzfeldt rescued!
levelComplete.next: Get ready for the next level...

victory.heading: VICTORY!
victory.message: Jumpman Løkke rescued Motzfeldt from every level.
victory.replay: Press Enter to return to the title screen

loading.slow: Still loading. Hang tight, the game is preparing.

errors.unsupportedBrowser: Donkey Trump needs a modern desktop browser with Canvas or WebGL rendering and keyboard support. Please try the latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
errors.assetLoadFailure: Some game files could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
errors.invalidLevelData: This level could not be loaded. Please reload the page.
